notes.title: 😻 Nekograms is available MEOW!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478120/Nekograms/

Come forth and rejoice, Nekofans. These kitties need your puzzle skills! Every cat needs a comfy cushion to fall asleep.

[b]Nekograms is 20% off until March 23rd to celebrate the launch![/b]

Play through 120 levels over 3 unique worlds. Discover 15 different cat breeds, enjoy the relaxing original soundtrack, and unlock Endless Mode to ascend through different states of cat consciousness.

Thanks for all your support! This is the first title we’ve released on Steam!

[b]Please leave Nekograms a review! It really helps others find it on Steam 🙏🏻[/b]

Kind Regards,
Hungry Sky

notes.title: 🗓️ Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Nekograms will launch on Steam on 10 March 🎉[/b]

Puzzle through 120 levels across 3 unique worlds with an unlockable Endless Mode. Help all the kitties to sleep in the least number of moves to collect all the stars.

[b]Wishlist to be notified as soon as Nekograms drops on Steam:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478120/Nekograms/

Thank you so much for checking out the Nekograms Demo during Next Fest. It’s still available if you haven't had a chance to check it out.

Kind Regards,
Hungry Sky

notes.title: 🐾 Thank You for Visiting Us at Pixel Expo and PAX! 🐾
notes.content:
Hey there, amazing players! 👋
We want to send out a HUGE thank you to everyone who stopped by our booths at Pixel Expo in Perth and PAX in Melbourne! Meeting so many of you in person and seeing your enthusiasm for Nekograms was absolutely purr-fect. 😻 We’re so grateful to everyone who wishlisted the game—your support helps us bring our cozy little game to life. 💖
As we roll closer to the end of the year, we’re excited to announce that Nekograms is still on track for a 2025 release on Steam! 🎉 Your feedback and love keep us motivated, and we can’t wait for you to help even more cats find their ideal nap spots.

Thank you again for your amazing support,
Hungry Sky Games 🐾✨

notes.title: 🐾 Thank You for Your Purr-sistence! 🐾
notes.content:
Hey there, wonderful players! 👋

First off, we just want to extend a massive thank you to everyone who's been along for the journey so far. Whether you’ve been with us since the beginning or joined us more recently during the Wholesome Games Celebration—we appreciate you all more than you know! 💖

We're super excited to share that we're setting our sights on Steam Next Fest in February! 🚀 You'll be able to get your paws on a demo just before or during the event, and if all goes to plan, the full game will be available for purchase shortly after! 🎉

We can’t wait for you to experience more of Nekograms and help our adorable cats find their perfect nap spots. 😻

Thanks for your ongoing support, 
Hungry Sky Games
